heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are hereby authorized to be appropriated the sums of not more than $2,130,000 for the acquisition of lands and interests in land and not more than $9,300,000 for construction, restoration work, and other improvements at the Nez Perce National Historical Park under this subchapter.

ancestors.heading: NATIONAL PARKS, MILITARY PARKS, MONUMENTS, AND SEASHORES
